purpose: Independently test technical, editorial, brand, rights and lineage requirements on each master.
hard_gates: Truth, rights, naming, transcript fidelity, safe zones, media specs and exact lineage must pass.
soft_gates: The finished master should meet the approved premium visual and editorial intent.

failure.fallback: Return the exact failed checks to their owning upstream station and rerun only descendants.

regression_cases: Captions outside safe zones block final approval.
A legacy series name in public output fails the package path.
